basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore Project Research Scientist I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Applications are invited from motivated and eligible candidates for one Project Research Scientist-I position in the research project supported by ICMR at the Mehta Family School of Biosciences and Biomedical Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Indore. The position is appointment for 1 year, extendable further if the candidate’s performance is found satisfactory, with a consolidated monthly salary of ₹ 67,200. Eligible candidates can apply online through the provided Google Form link on or before October 31, 2026.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Indore Project Research Scientist-I
content_sections.text: The Mehta Family School of Biosciences and Biomedical Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology Indore is executing an ICMR-supported research project titled "Ultrasound mediated drug delivery mechanism for cirrhotic liver using micro-physiological units." The selected Project Research Scientist-I will work under the supervision of Dr. Hitendra Kumar (Principal Investigator) and Dr. Lokesh Basavarajappa (Co-Principal Investigator), Assistant Professors at the Mehta Family School of Biosciences and Biomedical Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Indore.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential qualification requirements prescribed by IIT Indore for the Project Research Scientist-I post. Essential Qualification: PhD Degree in engineering (Electrical engineering / Medical physics / Biomedical engineering / Instrumentation engineering / electronics engineering / Engineering Physics / Mechanical Engineering) OR Minimum first class M. Tech degree in engineering (Electrical engineering / Medical physics / Biomedical engineering / Instrumentation engineering / electronics engineering / Engineering Physics / Mechanical Engineering) with a valid GATE qualification OR Minimum first class Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Electrical engineering / Medical physics / Biomedical engineering / Instrumentation engineering / electronics engineering / Engineering Physics / Mechanical Engineering) with a valid GATE qualification. First Class is defined as per the IIT Indore standards (https://academic.iiti.ac.in/phdadvt.php). Desirable Qualification: Candidates with knowledge of 3D printing, basic electronics, mechatronics, and signal processing. Prior experience in ultrasound is preferred. Prior experience in biomaterials development and characterization is preferred. Good communication skills. Age Limit: Preferably below 30 years.

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Project Research Scientist-I Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected Project Research Scientist-I will contribute to the development of ultrasound setup for drug delivery applications. The Project Research Scientist-I will also be involved in cell culture and 3D printing to develop a cirrhotic liver using micro-physiological units.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Indore Project Research Scientist-I
content_sections.text: Interested candidates are requested to apply for the position through Google form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScTDX1G8P_I3aHQ3eSmRocrQUx3hvCa9KwMwTjdwfzTyg___Q/viewform?usp=dialog or https://forms.gle/43wUwa4BzWyhGMh37. Submit the application form by October 31, 2026. Incomplete applications will be rejected. For any technical problem with submitting the application, please write to [email protected] or [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be informed about the date of the interview by email. The appointment is purely temporary and may be co-terminus with the project. Mere possession of minimum qualifications does not guarantee an invitation to the interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their merit and as per the requirement of the project. Google meet link will be shared only with the shortlisted candidates before the date of the interview. Interview Date: Would be communicated by November 10, 2026.
